heading: Proven Leadership. Real Solutions. A Better Future for Hillsborough County.
text: Hillsborough County is one of the best places in America to live, work, and raise a family.

heading: Proven Leadership. Real Solutions. A Better Future for Hillsborough County.
text: But residents know we face serious challenges.

heading: Proven Leadership. Real Solutions. A Better Future for Hillsborough County.
text: After years of the same leadership, voters have an important choice to make.

heading: Proven Leadership. Real Solutions. A Better Future for Hillsborough County.
text: Jackie Toledo is an engineer, mother, small business owner, and former State Representative who has spent her career delivering solutions, managing budgets, and bringing people together to get things done.

heading: Proven Leadership. Real Solutions. A Better Future for Hillsborough County.
text: She has the experience to lead and the determination to deliver.

heading: Endorsements
text: Jackie Toledo is endorsed state and local leaders dedicated to making HIllsborough County a better place to work and live.

heading: Endorsements
text: Blaise Ingoglia - Florida CFO Jackie Toledo is exactly the kind of conservative leader Hillsborough County needs. Jackie knows that government doesn't have a revenue problem; it has a spending problem. She will stand up to the big spenders, cut government waste, and deliver tax cuts. I'm proud to endorse Jackie Toledo because she will make government live within its means.

heading: Endorsements
text: Danny Alvarez - State Representative It is my great pleasure to endorse Jackie Toledo for Hillsborough County Commission. Jackie served as a State Representative for 6 years and her accomplishments are well known. Her solid relationships and working knowledge of the State Legislature will benefit Hillsborough citizens daily. I look forward to working with her when she serves on the County Commission. She is an engineer and a business owner who knows how to solve problems, and she will bring a needed voice to the citizens of Hillsborough County. Hillsborough County needs Jackie!

heading: Endorsements
text: Michael Owen - State Representative Jackie Toledo understands the challenges facing Hillsborough County. Our county needs leaders who will stand up for taxpayers, support law enforcement, encourage responsible growth and bring greater accountability to county government. As an engineer and former state legislator, Jackie brings a practical perspective and valuable experience to the table. Vote Jackie Toledo on November 3rd.

heading: Endorsements
text: Mike Beltran - State Representative Jackie and I represented neighboring districts in the Florida State House, and she always worked super hard for her constituents and to advance common sense policy. I look forward to Jackie applying her expertise in engineering and urban planning to the transportation issues here in Hillsborough.

heading: Endorsements
text: Scott "Coach" Levinson - l am here to enthusiastically endorse Jackie Toledo for Hillsborough County Commissioner District 1. As a life- long citizen of Hillsborough County I have complete confidence that the knowledge, experience, and dedication that Jackie possesses is exactly what is needed to lead our County into an extremely bright and successful future. Please join me and vote for Jackie Toledo on November 3rd.

heading: Fix Traffic and Improve Mobility
text: Traffic congestion impacts every family, every commuter, and every business.

heading: Fix Traffic and Improve Mobility
text: For too long, transportation infrastructure has struggled to keep pace with growth.

heading: Fix Traffic and Improve Mobility
text: Jackie will focus on accelerating transportation improvements, reducing congestion, improving traffic flow, and ensuring infrastructure investments are made strategically and efficiently.

heading: Fix Traffic and Improve Mobility
text: Explore innovative transportation alternatives.

heading: Fix Traffic and Improve Mobility
text: Residents deserve solutions—not excuses.

heading: Responsible Growth
text: Growth is inevitable. Poor planning is not.

heading: Responsible Growth
text: Jackie believes infrastructure should come before unchecked development and that growth must be managed responsibly. She will work to implement smarter planning, better infrastructure coordination, protect neighborhoods and for greater transparency in development decisions. Work to develop affordable housing options with transportation coordination within our urban core.

heading: Public Safety First
text: Public safety is the most important responsibility of local government.

heading: Public Safety First
text: Jackie will strongly support law enforcement, firefighters, emergency responders, and emergency management professionals who keep our communities safe.

heading: Protect Taxpayers
text: Families are watching every dollar. County government should do the same. Jackie will work to ensure transparency and accountability, discipline in government spending, eliminate waste and prioritize core services. Many challenges face Hillsborough County, and the people deserve a strong advocate for value and results.

heading: Flood Protection and Storm Preparedness
text: Hurricanes and severe weather have demonstrated the importance of preparation.

heading: Flood Protection and Storm Preparedness
text: Jackie will prioritize infrastructure resilience, stormwater improvements, flood mitigation, and emergency preparedness to protect residents and property.
